experiments_or_tasks: Caco-2 cells were incubated with [U-13C,15N]-labeled serine to monitor newly synthesized SLs, with or without Sa (d17:0) supplementation.

methods.name: Caco-2 cell culture and lipid competition
methods.protocol_description: Human epithelial colorectal adenocarcinoma cells (Caco-2, ATCC) were cultured in DMEM with 10% FBS at 37°C with 5% CO2. Plates seeded at 5×10^5 cells per 10 cm plate, experiments 48 h after seeding. Sphinganine (d18:0) added at 5 µM (or 1 µM in repeat), sphinganine (d17:0) at 0, 5, 10, 50 µM (or 0.5, 1, 2, 10 µM). Incubation for 1 h. For isotopic labeling, [U-13C,15N]-serine at 2.2 mM added with 5 µM Sa (d17:0); SLs quantified at 60 and 120 min.
